_doc: Per-species scan overrides. scan_prep: lateral/flip/beak_base/body_end/pitch_deg/tail_cut/cut_margin/root_margin/tris0. build_bird: wing_paint = photo (every wing card from the scan's wing photo) or art (default: flight feathers keep species_art.py's painted pattern, coverts from the photo). art_all: every wing card painted (no photo), for two-tone wings where the photo matched to the back goes wrong.

CommonSwift.keep_old: scan body broke into debris (clinging pose). Old model kept.

MuteSwan.keep_old: S-neck: chord centreline loses the head; medial centreline reaches it but the template's neck pose folds the head onto the chest. Old model kept; needs a straight-neck re-scan (sheet_11 ready, no hi3d points).

CommonBuzzard.keep_old: huge wing-root cut leaves a hollow back, far wing sticks up. Old model kept.

GreyHeron.keep_old: S-neck like MuteSwan. Old model kept.

BlueTit.keep_old: folded wing/scapular cards stick out of the scan body. Old model kept for now.
